title: Kerala in 3 days: Munnar, Thekkady and Alleppey
summary: Land at 03:30, sleep in the vehicle to Munnar, then tea hills, jeep trails, a Kalaripayattu show and the backwaters, home on a late flight.

days.title: Kochi Airport to Munnar: waterfalls, tea and the hills

transit.notes: Flight number is not in the source: confirm on the airline.

schedule.activity: Land at Kochi. Driver meets you at arrivals with a name board; 45 minutes to freshen up.
Depart for Munnar (130 km, about 4 hours with stops). Everyone sleeps in the Tempo Traveller.
Breakfast at a highway dhaba in Kothamangalam
schedule.notes: Puttu + kadala curry, idiyappam + egg curry, hot chai.

schedule.activity: Cheeyappara Waterfalls on NH85 (30 min)
schedule.tip: Slippery rocks: stay away from the edge.

schedule.activity: Reach Munnar and check in at Sea Grace Cottage; rest an hour
schedule.tip: Call the owner the night before to confirm early check-in at 09:30.

schedule.activity: Attukad Waterfalls
schedule.notes: 9 km from town on a narrow road; the Tempo Traveller parks at the base, 5-minute walk.

schedule.activity: Lunch at a local restaurant in Munnar town
Tea Museum (KDHP), about 45 minutes
Mattupetty Dam and a boat on the lake
Echo Point
Top Station viewpoint
Munnar town street food and spice shopping
schedule.notes: Parotta + beef fry, pazham pori, cardamom chai.

schedule.activity: Back at the cottage; bonfire if the owner can arrange it. Sleep by 22:00 for a 05:30 start.
schedule.tip: Ask the owner tonight to arrange 2 jeeps for Kolukkumalai at 06:30.

warnings: Tea Museum closes at 17:00: it must be done before then.

days.title: Kolukkumalai sunrise jeeps, then Thekkady

schedule.activity: Wake up and a quick breakfast
Drive to Suryanelli base (35 km, about 1 hour)
Kolukkumalai tea estate jeep safari (about 2 hours)
schedule.notes: The Tempo Traveller cannot go up: transfer to 2 pre-arranged jeeps.
schedule.tip: Backup viewpoints near Munnar: Lockhart Gap or Pothamedu.

schedule.activity: Back at the base, check out and depart for Thekkady via NH85 (91 km, about 3 hours in the monsoon)
Lunch in Kumily, then check in at Ferndale Homestay
schedule.notes: Parotta + chicken or fish curry. Avoid tourist restaurants near the Periyar gate: overpriced.

schedule.activity: Sathram jeep safari near the Periyar Tiger Reserve border (about 3 hours)
schedule.notes: Wildlife sighting is not guaranteed (about 40% chance of elephants, bison, deer).

schedule.activity: Kalaripayattu show at Kadathanadan Kalari Centre, Kumily (about 2 hours)
schedule.tip: Book in advance for the group.

schedule.activity: Dinner in Kumily

warnings: Jeeps may cancel in extreme heavy rain: use the backup viewpoints.

days.title: Thekkady to Alleppey, then the late flight home

transit.notes: Flight number is not in the source: confirm on the airline. Web check-in on the morning of Day 3.

schedule.activity: Breakfast near the homestay and checkout
Depart for Alleppey via Changanassery (138 km, about 3.5 hours): hills to paddy fields and backwaters
Alleppey Beach (45 min) and its 150-year-old iron pier
schedule.tip: No swimming in the monsoon: waves are rough and dangerous.

schedule.activity: Alappuzha Lighthouse (45 min, climb 5 floors)
Kumarakom Bird Sanctuary and a boat ride on Vembanad Lake (1.5 hours)
Lunch and a chill at Asado Cafe or Cafe Catamaran
schedule.notes: Karimeen pollichathu, filter coffee, banana pancakes.

schedule.activity: Depart Alleppey for Kochi Airport (83 km, about 2 hours with buffer)
Reach the airport: dinner, charge phones, duty-free (Kerala tea, banana chips, spices)
Check-in and security; at the gate by 22:30
Flight to Pune

warnings: Depart Alleppey by 16:30 without fail: 83 km to the airport, Sunday traffic, flight at 23:04.
Alleppey Beach in the monsoon: no swimming.

packing: Cash: Top Station and the lighthouse take cash only
disclaimers: Ratings, costs and timings are as recorded at design time (June, monsoon): re-check for your dates.
before_you_book: Web check-in on the morning of Day 3, 24 hours before the flight.
Pre-book the Kalaripayattu show (18:00 slot) for the whole group.
Ask the Munnar owner to arrange 2 jeeps for Kolukkumalai at 06:30 and confirm 09:30 early check-in.

route: Kochi Airport to Munnar via NH85: 130 km, about 4 hours with stops
Munnar to Kolukkumalai base (Suryanelli): 35 km, about 1 hour
Munnar to Thekkady / Kumily via NH85: 91 km, about 3 hours in the monsoon
Thekkady to Alleppey via Changanassery: 138 km, about 3.5 hours
Alleppey to Kochi Airport via NH66: 83 km, about 2 hours with buffer
critical_notes: Leave Alleppey by 16:30 without fail: Sunday traffic, flight at 23:04, airport by 18:30.
The Tempo Traveller cannot go up Kolukkumalai: the group changes to jeeps at the base.
Attukad Waterfalls: narrow road, park at the base.
